document_metadata.document_name: HDFC Bank Limited - Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the Quarter Ended September 30, 2026 (Q2 FY27)

official_filing_text: HDFC Bank Limited reported standalone net profit of Rs 16,821 crore for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Deposit growth continued to outpace gross advances growth, with total deposits growing at 15.1% YoY while advances grew at 7.0% YoY, progressing the glide path to moderate the credit to deposit ratio. The Credit to Deposit (C/D) ratio stood at 98.4% as of September 30, 2026, compared to 101.4% in the prior year period. Gross non-performing assets were at 1.11% of gross advances as on September 30, 2026, as against 1.34% as on September 30, 2025. Net non-performing assets were at 0.33% of net advances. Annualized credit cost for the quarter was 0.42%. Total Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR) as per Basel III guidelines was 19.3% against regulatory requirement of 11.5%, with Tier 1 at 18.9%. Net interest margin on total assets was 3.16% for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Branch additions were disciplined at 380 branches over the past 12 months as the bank focused on operational efficiency and sweating existing distribution capacity.
